tagline: Stop paying freight bills you never agreed to.
subtitle: Seed round  |  November 2026  |  founders@harborlane.example  |  Fictional demo company

problem.title: Mid-market shippers overpay on freight and only find out after the bill is paid

points.head: Invoices arrive faster than anyone can check them
points.body: Thousands of carrier invoices a month, each with contract rates, fuel and accessorial lines.

points.head: Audit happens in spreadsheets, after payment
points.body: One analyst re-rates a sample by hand; the rest is paid on trust.

points.head: Claims windows close before errors surface
points.body: Most carriers allow about 180 days to dispute, then the overcharge is permanent.

stat.label: of freight invoices contain a billing error, according to industry audit benchmarks

solution.title: Harborlane re-rates every invoice line against your contract before you pay
solution.statement: One connection to your TMS and carrier EDI feeds turns freight spend from a leak into a controlled, auditable process.

pillars.head: Audit 100% of lines
pillars.body: Contracts are parsed once; every invoice line is re-rated automatically, not sampled.

pillars.head: Pay the right amount
pillars.body: Errors are flagged pre-payment, so approvers pay the corrected amount instead of chasing refunds.

pillars.head: Recover the rest
pillars.body: Disputes are drafted and filed within the claims window, with evidence attached.

why_now.title: Three shifts have made continuous freight audit possible and urgent

items.head: Carriers moved to dynamic accessorial pricing
items.body: Surcharges change monthly, so static rate checks and annual audits miss more every year.

items.head: Invoice data is finally machine-readable
items.body: Most mid-market carriers now deliver structured invoices, removing the OCR and manual entry step.

items.head: Rate volatility put freight on the CFO's agenda
items.body: Finance leaders want controls and variance explanations, not a yearly recovery report.

market.title: A {tam_title} bottom-up market, with a clear path to our first {som_title}

sam.label: Shippers on a TMS we integrate with

assumptions: Account counts are from public shipper-spend datasets and our CRM; ACV equals today's blended contract value.
SAM covers the TMS and ERP platforms we already integrate with; more are on the roadmap.
SOM assumes a 5% win rate on SAM; it ignores expansion revenue and international shippers.

product.title: Connect once, and every invoice is audited, corrected and disputed automatically

steps.head: Connect
steps.body: Link the TMS, ERP and carrier EDI feeds. Upload contracts; our parser extracts rate tables.

steps.head: Audit
steps.body: Every line is re-rated and scored. Duplicates, wrong accessorials and rate drift are flagged.

steps.head: Recover
steps.body: Approvers pay the corrected amount, and disputes go to the carrier with evidence attached.

capabilities.head: Contract-aware
capabilities.body: Tiered, lane-based and zone-based rates are modelled, not approximated.

capabilities.head: Pre-payment
capabilities.body: Findings arrive before the AP run, so money is never paid out.

capabilities.head: Audit trail
capabilities.body: Every adjustment is explainable and exportable for finance review.

capabilities.head: Live in two weeks
capabilities.body: Self-serve onboarding with no consulting engagement.
